title: PowerToys运行时ALT键松发BUG问题：Alt 物理按下不触发，物理松开立刻触发按下与松开

actions.label: Mark duplicate of Grab And Move stuck modifier report
actions.note: Draft a maintainer duplicate note pointing to the canonical stuck-modifier issue.

comment.body: I re-checked this report against issue 50248, and the core symptom set matches: Grab and Move leaves Alt/Win modifier state desynchronized so shortcuts fail and keyboard testing sees the modifier behave as if only release is reaching the system. This issue adds useful repro color (FancyZones enabled, preview timing, Chinese description), but it still points to the same stuck-modifier family. I would keep the implementation investigation consolidated under issue 50248 rather than splitting the fix across two parallel reports.

issue_context.summary: The Chinese report describes an Alt key that only “releases” into the system after physical release, which matches the same Grab and Move stuck-modifier family already described in issue 50248.
known_information: The report explicitly ties the symptom to Grab and Move and notes that uninstalling PowerToys removes the problem.
It mentions FancyZones and Grab And Move both being enabled, and shows a keyboard-test screenshot.
The key symptom matches 50248: Alt-based shortcuts fail and keyboard testing sees an unusable keydown/keyup sequence.
inferences: The two reports are likely different reproductions of the same absorbed-modifier/state-sync bug family rather than separate product defects.
issue_context.analysis: This is better handled as duplicate coverage. Keeping the design work on one canonical stuck-modifier issue avoids splitting evidence and implementation planning.
initial_investigation: Re-read the entire issue body and the attached screenshot reference.
Compared the symptom set against issue 50248 and found the same core modifier failure pattern.
Used the current Grab And Move source to confirm both issues point into the same absorbed-modifier state machine.

judgment.rationale: This issue describes the same stuck-Alt/keyup-only Grab and Move failure pattern as issue 50248, just with more emphasis on FancyZones being enabled and on preview-build timing.
evidence: Issue 50236 says physical Alt down does not register, keydown and keyup appear together on release, and Alt+Tab/Alt+Esc fail.
Issue 50248 reports the same keyboard-tester observation (keyup without usable keydown) and the same loss of Alt/Win shortcuts while Grab and Move is active.
Both reports localize the symptom to Grab and Move and describe it as timing- or foreground-sensitive rather than a permanent boot-time failure.
judgment.recommended_action: Mark this as duplicate coverage under the newer stuck-modifier report and keep future design/fix work consolidated there.

fix_assessment.rationale: The right next step is to consolidate investigation under the better-tracked stuck-modifier issue instead of splitting design work across two near-identical reports.
